task_name: Open Terminal and run pwd. Leave the output visible.
instruction: Open Terminal and run `pwd`. Leave the output visible.

task_name: Open Terminal, run cd ~/Desktop && pwd, and keep the result on screen.
instruction: Open Terminal, run `cd ~/Desktop && pwd`, and keep the result on screen.

task_name: Use which to resolve a script path.
instruction: Open Terminal and run `which ~/Scripts/fizzbuzz.sh`. Leave the output visible.

task_name: Use whereis to locate a script path.
instruction: Open Terminal and run `whereis ~/Scripts/fizzbuzz.sh`. Leave the output visible.

task_name: Count words in a sentence with wc.
instruction: In Terminal, run `echo hello world from prozilla | wc -w` and leave the output visible.

task_name: Create a file in Documents using touch.
instruction: In Terminal, run `cd ~/Documents && touch benchmark_note.txt && ls`, and keep the output visible.

task_name: Create nested folders and verify with tree.
instruction: In Terminal, run `cd ~/Documents && mkdir -p logs/2026 && tree -L 2 logs`, and leave the result visible.
Open Terminal and run `id`. Leave the identity line visible.

task_name: Write a single word in Text Editor.
instruction: Open the Text Editor, clear the current content, type `fizzbuzz`, and keep it visible.

task_name: Write two lines in Text Editor.
instruction: Open the Text Editor and enter exactly two lines: first `hello`, second `prozilla benchmark`.
